name: Indian Sign Gestures Dataset (Signdetectnet)
description: A benchmark dataset for detecting Indian sign gestures in real-world scenes to evaluate lightweight sign language detection models.
evaluation_method: mAP (mean Average Precision) for detection; per-class detection/recognition accuracy
reputation: A specialized dataset aimed at lightweight detection of Indian sign gestures with limited adoption beyond targeted research groups.
notes: Real-world scenes but likely smaller-scale and task-specific; non-LLM benchmark; may have class imbalance or limited diversity depending on collection.
